summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces. Namespace.__contains__ does a prefix test (ref.startswith(self)). ClosedNamespace.__contains__ checks node-type-aware equality against stored term URIs; _RDFNamespace inherits it. The IPython key-completion hook now returns dir(str(self.uri)). Added tests to test/test_namespace.py covering prefix positive/negative/self cases, RDFS closed positive/negative and non-URIRef negatives, RDF closed positive and container-property negative, and SH. Tests were not run, per instructions. Nothing is committed.
